Bodyguard Booking Platform – Project Requirements

We will develop a Bodyguard Booking Platform consisting of iOS and Android mobile applications for customers and bodyguards, along with a web-based Super Admin Panel.

1\. Bodyguard App

\* Register and create a professional profile.  
\* Upload identity documents, background-check details, licenses, certifications, and photos.  
\* Pay a one-time registration fee through Stripe.  
\* Submit the profile for admin approval.  
\* Set hourly rates and manage availability through a calendar.  
\* Receive and manage bookings.  
\* Chat with customers and share live location during active bookings.  
\* View ratings, earnings, wallet balance, and transaction history.  
\* Request payouts by submitting bank details.

2\. Customer App

\* Register and manage their profile.  
\* Search nearby bodyguards using filters such as hourly rate, ratings, certifications, and availability.  
\* View bodyguard profiles, experience, and reviews.  
\* Book bodyguards for the required date, time, and number of hours.  
\* Pay for bookings through Stripe.  
\* Purchase membership plans offering 10%, 20%, or 30% discounts on eligible bookings.  
\* Chat with the booked bodyguard and track their live location.  
\* Share the bodyguard’s live location with family members.  
\* View booking history and rate/review bodyguards after completed bookings.

3\. Web Admin Panel

\* Manage customers and bodyguards.  
\* Review documents and approve, reject, block, or unblock bodyguard profiles.  
\* Manage membership plans, discounts, hourly rates, and platform commission.  
\* View and manage all bookings, transactions, and booking-related chats.  
\* Monitor bodyguard earnings and wallet balances.  
\* Review payout requests and manually transfer money to bodyguards’ bank accounts.  
\* Update payout statuses from Pending to Completed.  
\* Manage ratings, reviews, notifications, and platform reports.

4\. Booking, Payment, and Commission Flow

Customers select a bodyguard, choose the booking duration, apply any eligible membership discount, and pay through Stripe. Once the booking is completed and settlement conditions are met, the platform calculates the admin commission and bodyguard earnings.

For example, on a \$100 commissionable booking with a 20% admin commission, \$20 goes to the platform and \$80 is allocated to the bodyguard, before any separately applicable fees or deductions.

The bodyguard can request a payout from their available wallet balance. The admin processes the bank transfer manually and updates the payout status.

5\. Additional Features

\* Real-time chat and live location tracking.  
\* Family location sharing with appropriate access controls.  
\* Booking and payment notifications.  
\* Secure document storage and role-based access.  
\* Booking, payment, commission, wallet, and payout history.

Note: The final Stripe payment and settlement flow, cancellation/refund policies, membership validity, and background-verification process will be confirmed before development begins.
